raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`convrot_int8`'s comfy_kitchen backend splits tall GEMMs into 8192-row calls (`SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS`) to keep them off comfy_kitchen's Stream-K schedule. Every extra call also copies its slice of the output, and with comfy-kitchen 0.2.37 whole-model runs are faster unsplit on every GPU we measured.

## Modifications

- Default `SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS` to `0` (one call per layer). A positive value still splits.
- Update the comment in `convrot_int8_comfy_kitchen.py`, `environment_variables.mdx` and `quantization.mdx`.

## Accuracy Tests

Splitting rows does not change any row's arithmetic. Outputs are bit-identical with and without the split (same-input ablation on all three GPUs).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MiniMax-H3 pruned INT8 checkpoint, comfy_kitchen backend, SGLD ComfyUI workflow, 4 steps × 3 seeds. Steady model-time gain going from rows 8192 to 0:

| GPU | 480p / 124 frames | 768p / 124 frames | Ref2VA / 4 refs |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| RTX 4090 | +3.91% | +2.40% | +2.14% |
| RTX 5090 | +2.96% | +1.62% | +1.26% |
| H200 (kitchen forced) | +2.20% | +1.56% | +1.48% |

H200, B200 and RTX 5090 default to the JIT backend, which does not use this setting. RTX 4090 (sm89) always uses comfy_kitchen.

- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch: @@ -85,13 +85,13 @@ description: "Configure SGLang diffusion behavior with environment variables." SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS - 8192 - Max activation rows per convrot_int8 fused GEMM on the comfy_kitchen backend. Set 0 to disable row splitting. + 0 + Max activation rows per convrot_int8 fused GEMM on the comfy_kitchen backend. 0 (default) issues one call; a positive value splits large-M GEMMs by rows. SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MIN_SPLIT_N 8192 - Minimum output features before convrot_int8 (comfy_kitchen backend) splits large-M GEMMs. Narrow outputs stay as a single call. + Minimum output features before convrot_int8 (comfy_kitchen backend) splits large-M GEMMs when SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS is positive. Narrow outputs stay as a single call.

@@ -498,10 +498,12 @@ for the 24 GB offload recipe, including why `vae` must stay out of
 `--layerwise-offload-components`.
 </Warning>
 
-With the `comfy_kitchen` backend, large-M GEMMs (`rows > 8192` and
-`out_features >= 8192`) are split by rows so the fused kernel stays on the
-data-parallel CUTLASS config. Override the thresholds with
-`SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS` and `SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MIN_SPLIT_N`.
+With the `comfy_kitchen` backend, each GEMM is one fused call by default.
+`SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS=N` splits large-M GEMMs (`rows > N` and
+`out_features >= SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MIN_SPLIT_N`, default 8192) into N-row
+calls, which keeps them on comfy_kitchen's data-parallel CUTLASS config; on
+MiniMax-H3 with comfy-kitchen 0.2.37 the extra calls and output copies cost more
+than they save.
 
 ### Skipping Layers

@@ -35,16 +35,11 @@
 # comfy_kitchen's dtype codes for the fused op's output.
 _OUT_DTYPE_CODE = {torch.float32: 0, torch.float16: 1, torch.bfloat16: 2}
 
-# comfy_kitchen picks its CUTLASS tile configuration from a threshold tree
-# (select_fused_int8_config in cutlass_gemm_int8.cu). Shapes whose N falls under
-# its 24832 cutoff but whose M is large get a Stream-K schedule, which exists to
-# balance load when there are too few tiles to fill the GPU. At H3's 32700 tokens
-# qkv_proj already launches ~21k CTAs over the 4090's 128 SMs, so Stream-K's
-# workspace and fixup reduction are pure overhead: 26.5 ms against 17.9 ms for
-# the identical tile without it. Capping rows per call keeps the plain
-# data-parallel config, and is bit-exact because splitting rows does not change
-# any single row's arithmetic.
-_MAX_ROWS_PER_CALL = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS", "8192"))
+# Rows per comfy_kitchen int8_linear call; 0 issues one call. Splitting keeps tall,
+# narrow-N GEMMs off comfy_kitchen's Stream-K schedule, but every extra call also
+# copies its slice of the output, and whole-model MiniMax-H3 runs (comfy-kitchen
+# 0.2.37, pruned INT8) are 1.3-3.9% faster unsplit on RTX 4090, RTX 5090 and H200.
+_MAX_ROWS_PER_CALL = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MAX_ROWS", "0"))
 # Narrow outputs do not recover the cost of writing results back through a
 # preallocated buffer; H3's out_proj and fc2 (N=5376) both measure slower split.
 _MIN_SPLIT_OUTPUT = int(os.environ.get("SGLANG_KITCHEN_INT8_MIN_SPLIT_N", "8192"))
